headline: Dolly's NAILS Drop ANTHEM FIRE 💅🎤 HEART and FURY!
text:
BACK 🗓️ in 1980 📅 Dolly Mama 💅 WAS FILMING 🎥 her FIRST 🥇 HOLLYWOOD 🎬 MOVIE 🎞️ 9 TO 5 🕒 when her GUITAR 🎸 WAS BANNED 🚫 from the SET 🏛️ so she CUMPOSED 🥜 the BEAT 🥁 by STRUMMING 🖐️ her ACRYLIC 💅 NAILS 🫲 together she REALIZED 👀 the SOUND 🛎️ MATCHED the TYPEWRITER ⌨️ used by her CHARACTER 👩‍💼 a MARRIED 💍 SECRETARY 📝 CONSTANTLY BELITTLED 🙇 and SEXUALLY HARASSED 🍑 by her BOSS 👔. EXCITED 🥵 she SANG 🎤 the SONG 🎵 to co STARS ⭐ Lily Tomlin and Jane Fonda who got GOOSEBUMPS 🦢 and DECLARED 📢 it was not just a MOVIE song but an ANTHEM 🔥💥!!

DOLLY MAMA 💅 DROPPED her ONLY 🥇 US number one ANTHEM 🎤 in NOVEMBER 🗓️ 1980 that earned her an OSCAR 🏆 nomination for BEST SONG after making POWERFUL statements about the GRIND 🏭 of WORKING LIFE 💼 and women's place 👠 in the corporate world 🏢!! That jaunty hook 🪝 is universally catchy with the line Working 9 To 5 ⏰ What a way to make a living 💰 but the lyrics express REAL FURY 😡 at a rich man's game 🎲 where workers 🧑‍🔧 spend their lives putting money in his wallet 🤑 and never get credit!! "She had us all on our KNEES 🙇 begging for that hook 😩" moaned one fan 🥴 "but Dolly MAMA 🍑 really POUNDED 💦💦 the patriarchy home" and this track is pure HEART ❤️ and FURY that still SLAPS to this day fr fr.

DOLLY 🧚 MAMA 💅 EARLY 🌱 BREAKTHROUGH 💥 CAME 🦶 in 1967 🗓️ when she was HIRED 🪝 as the GIRL 👧 SINGER 🎤 on The Porter Wagoner 🧔 Show 📺 reaching MILLIONS 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 WEEKLY 🗞️ Together they released 21 🎲 HIT 🥁 DUETS 🎶 including Just Someone I Used to Know 👤 If Teardrops Were Pennies 💰 and Please Don't Stop Loving Me 🛑💖 as her STAR 🌟 rose 📈 and OUTSHONE 🏆 Wagoner 🧔 she wrote 📝 I Will Always Love You 💌 as a LETTER 📨 of APOLOGY 🥺 to him he SUED 🏛️ her for BREACH 🔪 of CUMTRACT 🍆 in 1979 🗓️ demanding 3m 💵 and she SETTLED 🤝 for about 1m 💰 while choosing not to hold a GRUDGE 🐂 this was DOLLY 🍑 MAMA turning the TABLES 🔄 on that FURIOUS 💢 HEARTBREAK 💔 into an ANTHEM 🔥 that still SLAPS 👏 today 🕙!!

After 🎼 I Will Always ❤️ Love 💕 You hit 🥁 NUMBER 🏆 ONE on the country 🐮 charts 📈 Elvis 👑 wanted 🥵 to RECORD 🎤 it but his MANAGER 🧔 Colonel Tom Parker 🚨 demanded Dolly Mama 💅 hand 🤚 over HALF ✂️ the pubLICKING 🍆 rights 📜 like he was trying to get a PIECE 🍕 of the action 💦!! She refused 🙅 saying 🗣️ she was leaving 🚪 that to her family 👪 and CRIED 😭 all night 🌙 after the deal 🤝 fell 💥 apart 💔 but when Whitney 🎤 recorded 📝 her 1992 version for The Bodyguard 🛡️ Dolly Mama 💃 still owned 🏠 the rights 🗝️ and earned 💵 enough money 💰 to buy 🛍️ Graceland 🏡 which she invested 🏘️ in a black 🖤 neighbourhood 🏡 in Nashville 🎸 to HONOUR 🙏 Houston's LEGACY 🏅🔥 like a total POWER 💪 move after not getting screwed 🚫 in the first place 😳!!

DOLLY 🧓 MAMA 🍑 's 💪 determination 💪 to ➡️ stand 🧍 up ⬆️ for 👊 herself 👤 and 💎 value 💎 her 👩 music 🎤 as 📦 more 🔝 than a CUMmodity 🛒 is 🏛️ central 🏛️ to 👑 her 🏆 legacy 🏆 that 🌟 may 🌠 have 💡 inspired 💡 Taylor 🎤 Swift 🦋 to ➡️ stand 🧍 up 🆙 to 🏦 hedge 🏦 funds 💰 by 📼 re-recording 📼 her 🏅 biggest 🏅 hits 🎵!! Dolly 🍑 approved ✅ calling 🗣️ Swift 🦋 smart 🧠 and a genius 🧠 for 🤸 the move 🏃‍♀️ mourning 🕯️ her ☠️ death ☠️ Taylor 🦋 Swift 🦋 praised 🙌 Dolly 🍑 Mama's 🍑 backbone 🦴 of 🛠️ steel 🛠️ in 🛡️ defending 🛡️ her 👤 own 💪 self 💪 worth 💵 as 🧑 an artist 🧑‍🎨!! One anon 🕵️ staffer 🧑‍💼 admitted 🗣️ her backbone 🍆 of steel 🍆 had them 🧎 on their knees 🦵 begging 🥺 for more 😩 it was the horniest 🌶️ artist move 👀 they'd seen 🔥💯.

DOLLY 🪆 MAMA 💁‍♀️ WROTE ✍️ her FIRST 🎵 song at about AGE 🕒 six with LITTLE TINY TASSELTOP 🧸 about her DOLL 🧸 then LAID 🛠️ down the 1971 🗓️ COAT 🧥 OF MANY COLORS 🌈 about pride in ragged hand-sewn 👗 clothes and the 1974 📅 album 📼 MY TENNESSEE 🏔️ MOUNTAIN 🏠 HOME 🏡 that opens 📂 with her reciting 🗣️ the first letter ✉️ home from NASHVILLE 🎸. HITS 🎯 like JOLENE 👩 ALL I CAN DO 💪 WHEN POSSESSION 🫴 GETS TOO STRONG 💪 and JUST BECAUSE IM A WOMAN 👠 addressed ⚖️ double standards with lines such as My mistakes are no worse than yours just because Im a woman inspiring 🌟 women 👭 as she performed 🎭 JOLENE as drag queen 👠 in 2002 🗓️ gave 🎁 scholarships and supplied over 200 million 📚 books while remaining unique 🦄 and irreplaceable 💎 and one fan 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 gasped Dolly Mama 🍑 really STROKED 🫳 our souls with that HEART ❤️ and FURY 😤 and we were down bad for it 💦🔥
